description_en: Queries the history list of domain name tasks under your account by using paging
description_zh: 调用QueryTaskInfoHistory分页查询自己账户下的域名任务历史列表
name: QueryTaskInfoHistory

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the user. You can set this parameter to 127.0.0.1
parameters.name: user_client_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language of the error message returned by the API. Valid values:
zh: Chinese.
en: English.

Default value: en
parameters.help_zh:
接口返回错误信息语言。取值：
zh：中文；
en：英文。

默认为en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The start time of the creation date range to query. The time is calculated as the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since 00:00:00 UTC on January 1, 1970. Currently, only daily queries are supported
parameters.help_zh: 查询创建日期范围的开始时间，计算方式为UTC时间1970年1月1日0点距离现在的毫秒数，目前只支持按天查询
parameters.name: begin_create_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the creation date range to query. The time is calculated as the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since 00:00:00 UTC on January 1, 1970. Currently, only daily queries are supported
parameters.help_zh: 查询创建日期范围的结束时间，UTC时间1970年1月1日0点距离现在的毫秒数，目前只支持按天查询
parameters.name: end_create_time

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The cursor for the creation date. This is a technical parameter
parameters.help_zh: 创建日期的游标（技术参数）
parameters.name: create_time_cursor

parameters.help_en: The task cursor. Pass the task ID in the cursor of the corresponding page when you navigate to the next page. This is a technical parameter
parameters.help_zh: 任务光标，翻页时传入对应页游标中的任务编号（技术参数）
parameters.name: task_no_cursor

CurrentPageCursor.description_en: The cursor of the current page

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the task was created

CreateTimeLong.description_en: The timestamp when the task was created

TaskNum.description_en: The number of domain names included in the task

TaskStatus.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:
WAITING_EXECUTE: Waiting for execution.
EXECUTING: Executing.
COMPLETE: Completed
TaskStatus.description_zh:
任务状态。取值：
WAITING_EXECUTE；等待执行；
EXECUTING；执行中；
COMPLETE；执行完成

TaskStatusCode.description_en:
The task status code. Valid values:
1: Waiting for execution.
2: Executing.
3: Completed
TaskStatusCode.description_zh:
任务状态码。取值：
1：等待执行；
2：执行中；
3：执行完成
